newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks seen feeble, focus on funds, foreigners.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks seen feeble, focus on funds, foreigners.

text.p: Tokyo stocks are likely to wander feebly on Tuesday as market participants hunt for clues to provide trade with direction, brokers said. They said the focus would be on foreign investors and especially public funds, which could start bargain-hunting soon.
The Nikkei 225 fell 262.83 points or 1.32 percent to finish at 19,705.17 on Monday. Its September futures slipped 140 to 19,770.
"The Nikkei has sunk close to various support levels so technically buying on dips should start appearing," a general manager at a second-tier brokerage said.
